name: North Dakota

flag.description: A dark blue field with a bald eagle, wings spread, holding an olive branch and arrows and a ribbon reading "E Pluribus Unum", under 13 stars and a sunburst, with a red scroll below reading "North Dakota"; the flag has a gold fringe.
flag.symbolism: The design copies the regimental colors of the 1st North Dakota Infantry, and the eagle is the one from the US coat of arms.

hook: North Dakota has no seal at all: just a big American eagle on blue with a red "North Dakota" scroll below.
trivia: The flag is based on the banner carried by North Dakota troops in the Spanish–American War and the Philippine–American War.
North Dakota and South Dakota were admitted on the same day, 2 November 1889.
